description: Starfighter displayed at the Sivrihisar reserve air base. Construction number 683D-6030. The International F-104 Society records a two-tone grey scheme. An F-100 that stood 300 m away at 39.45709 31.37010 was recorded as removed by spottingmode on 8 July 2024 and is not included.
